title: Wider and Deeper LLM Networks are Fairer LLM Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of candidate responses in the prompt context to evaluate if the LLM's ranking or preference changes, and measuring stability and alignment with human judgments using benchmarks like FairEval.
Assessing the tendency of LLM evaluators to unfairly prefer longer candidate responses, evaluated by comparing the LLM network's automated judgments against human preference benchmarks.
